Summary Collaboration Themes: The collaboration between Sridhar Radhakrishnan and John Antonio bridges the gap between high-level network protocol design, stochastic performance modeling, and low-level embedded signal processing. By combining Radhakrishnan’s expertise in wireless sensor networks, RFID systems, and fuzzy logic optimization with Antonio’s innovations in ultrasonic communication, DSP-based embedded systems, and high-performance graph analytics, they can develop robust, multi-modal communication and sensing solutions for complex industrial environments. Key themes include hybrid acoustic-RF networking for supply chain security, real-time structural health monitoring, and intelligent, autonomous logistics systems that leverage both theoretical performance guarantees and practical hardware optimizations.
